visualCharacteristics.purpose: single horizontal linked card with an icon tile, title, description and chevron; the whole card is clickable
visualCharacteristics.layout: icon tile at left, text in the middle, chevron at right, inside a shadowed box

contentPattern.structure: one row: cell 1 icon or image; cell 2 heading (or bold title), description paragraph and a link to the destination (the first link in the cell covers the whole card)

cells: Heading, description paragraph, link (last paragraph becomes the CTA)

usage: Standalone promo link to a detail page, e.g. Lifetime Member Benefits.
reuseGuidance: Use for one prominent link row. For several cards in a grid use cards-image-link or cards-icon; for a vertical card use card.
